label: Photo QR
hint: The photograph is built from the QR. Each module’s center is the bit; the rest is a photo halftone.

label: Clean overlay
hint: The photo sits underneath at full strength; crisp modules with finder plates float on top — the poster look, maximum scannability.

label: Color blend
hint: Each module is one contrast-normalized color from the photo

label: Halftone
hint: Same lattice in black ink on paper — newspaper dots, not colored rings

label: Duotone
hint: Two inks sampled from the photo, same center-locked weave

label: Mono ink
hint: One ink on paper. Density follows the picture
